title: Nighttime Crunchy Malaysian Noodle Fried Rice
description: A midnight-craving Malaysian dish featuring umami and bouncy noodles, made with vegetable oil and raw-friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for satisfying late-night cravings.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the mixed vegetables and scallions, and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt, and pepper.
Pour the sauce mixture over the noodles and vegetables, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional scallions and soy sauce, if desired.
